text: This deprecation warning is coming from the dateutil library inside the venv, not our own code, so editing it directly isn't the right approach. Instead I should look at the pytest configuration to filter or suppress this warning so it doesn't get turned into an error.

This adds a filter to ignore the specific `datetime.utcfromtimestamp()` deprecation warning coming from the third-party `dateutil` package (a transitive dependency of `freezegun`), which otherwise gets escalated to a hard error by the `filterwarnings = error` setting and breaks test collection on Python 3.12. The warning originates in vendored/installed third-party code, not in this package's own source, so the fix belongs in the pytest warning filter rather than in itsdangerous itself.
